author: alireza-flhz
name: Clean Architecture API (generic CQRS, EF Core, JWT auth)
description: A layered Clean Architecture Web API: Domain/Application/Infrastructure/Api projects with dependencies pointing inward, a zero-dependency in-process CQRS mediator, generic CRUD over EF Core, register/login with JWT and BCrypt, international phone validation, API versioning, OpenAPI with Scalar UI, structured logging, and a test project per layer. Adding an entity takes a DTO, one AddCrudHandlers call, and a controller.

safeName.description: The project name, made safe to use as a C# namespace. A name that is not a valid identifier (my-api) becomes one (my_api) consistently in file names, project references and namespaces.

framework.description: Target framework for the generated projects. Choose the one your installed .NET SDK can build - 'dotnet --version' tells you which you have.

skipRestore.description: Skip the automatic 'dotnet restore' that normally runs after the project is created.

postActions.description: Restore NuGet packages required by this project.

manualInstructions.text:
1) Set a JWT signing key (at least 32 bytes) - protected endpoints stay 401 until you do:
     dotnet user-secrets init --project src/Api
     dotnet user-secrets set Jwt:SigningKey "<at least 32 bytes>" --project src/Api

2) Run it:
     dotnet run --project src/Api
   Then open http://localhost:5000/scalar/v1 for interactive API docs.
   GET /health and GET / work with no configuration at all.

3) Register a user to get a token:
     curl -X POST http://localhost:5000/api/v1/auth/register -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"email\":\"me@example.com\",\"password\":\"correct-horse-battery\"}"

4) Run the tests:
     dotnet test

5) Add your own entity: create it in src/Domain, add a DTO in src/Application,
   call services.AddCrudHandlers<YourEntity, int, YourDto>(), and derive a
   controller from BaseCrudController. Then delete the TodoItem sample.

Full guide: https://github.com/alireza-flhz/CleanArchitecture-Api-Template
